nieuw.titel: Deploy heavy chariots further back and bring them in patiently
nieuw.tekst: He recommends deploying heavy chariots further back and bringing them into the battle later, often around turn three. Avoid rushing forward just to set up an early charge.
nieuw.waarom: He warns that pushing forward for a turn-two charge can leave the chariot shot down or charged by cavalry or something with Swiftstride, then stuck dealing mediocre damage.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He welcomes a successful turn-two charge and says a turn-one opportunity is something the opponent has handed you.

bronnen.citaat: I believe they should be deployed further back

extraCitaten.citaat: they're charging things on turn three at best.

nieuw.titel: Give a supporting Black Orc chariot a standard bearer
nieuw.tekst: He values a standard bearer on a Black Orc Boar Chariot for the extra combat resolution it brings to a support charge. Combined with a flank charge, that supplies two combat resolution before impact hits do any damage.
nieuw.waarom: In his view, even one extra combat resolution can tip the scales in an existing fight.
nieuw.voorbeeld: In his game, a rear charge and the chariot's banner supplied three combat resolution; one impact-hit wound made it four and swung the combat.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He accepts that the standard can mean giving up points.

bronnen.citaat:
being able to bring a standard bearer on
a chariot is a fantastic addition.

extraCitaten.citaat: you're bringing two combat res in a support charge.
an extra plus one combat res is sometimes all it takes to tip the scales.

bron.citaat: Essentially, you should be considering heavy chariots as a rescue team.

extraCitaten.citaat: That allows you to support charge with the chariot.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He gives the same recommendation to pair a heavy chariot with a durable unit and countercharge after that unit holds or falls back in good order.

overgeslagen: Skipped introductions, guide and sponsor promotion, list readouts, rules explanations without separate advice, and unclear captions. The battle examples illustrate the support role already in the index.
